test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some goodies are baddies.

Some baddies are wolves.

All goodies are tigers.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some tigers are baddies.

(II) Some wolves are baddies.

options.text: Both Conclusion (I) and Conclusion (II) definitely follow.
Both Conclusion (I) and Conclusion (II) definitely donot follow.

solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d6cbc3c63d45951dc08733d0e2f8e4d7516c30e67ce3d79fddfc55046944393.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some tigers are baddies → True (because some goodies are baddies and all goodies are tigers so some tigers are also baddies)

(II) Some wolves are baddies → True (because statement given some baddies are wolves so some wolves are also baddies)

Hence, “**Both Conclusion (I) and Conclusion (II) definitely follow**".
